# Feature: Add Projects Management Route

## Overview
Create a dedicated `/projects` route and page where project management operations (create, list, delete projects) will be centralized. This separates project management from the main Kanban board, reducing cognitive load and providing a dedicated space for project CRUD operations. The page will display a list of all projects with create and delete controls.

## User Stories
- **As an Admin user**, I want to access a dedicated projects management page so that I can create and delete projects independently from the task board view.

## Implementation Plan

### UI Components
- **ProjectsPage component** — Main container for projects management
  - Located at `client/src/pages/ProjectsPage.jsx`
  - Displays all projects fetched from backend
  - Includes create project form
  - Lists existing projects with delete buttons
- **ProjectList component** — Reusable list display
  - Located at `client/src/components/ProjectList.jsx`
  - Maps over projects array and renders individual project items
- **CreateProjectForm component** — Form to add new projects
  - Located at `client/src/components/CreateProjectForm.jsx`
  - Input for project name
  - Submit button to create project

### Data Model (Mock)
Mock projects array:
```javascript
const mockProjects = [
  { id: 1, name: 'Backend API', created_at: '2026-08-28T10:00:00Z' },
  { id: 2, name: 'Frontend UI', created_at: '2026-08-28T11:00:00Z' },
  { id: 3, name: 'Documentation', created_at: '2026-08-28T12:00:00Z' }
]
```

### Simulated Backend
Use existing `api.js` service functions:
- `GET /api/projects/` — Fetch all projects
- `POST /api/projects/` — Create a new project
- `DELETE /api/projects/{id}/` — Delete a project

### Step-by-Step Implementation
1. Create `client/src/pages/` directory
2. Create `client/src/pages/ProjectsPage.jsx` with:
   - State for projects list
   - useEffect hook to fetch projects on mount
   - Conditional rendering (loading/error/success states)
   - Layout with heading and create form
3. Create `client/src/components/CreateProjectForm.jsx` with:
   - Text input for project name
   - Submit handler that calls `createProject()` from api.js
   - Success/error feedback
4. Create `client/src/components/ProjectList.jsx` with:
   - List of projects (from props)
   - Delete button per project
   - Delete handler that calls `deleteProject()` from api.js
5. Update `client/src/App.jsx` to route to ProjectsPage at `/projects` (feature 1 handles routing)
6. Style ProjectsPage using existing CSS variables from `client/src/index.css`
7. Test create, list, and delete operations

- Pages directory: [client/src/pages/](client/src/pages/)
- API service: [client/src/services/api.js](client/src/services/api.js)

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] ProjectsPage component displays all projects
- [ ] Create project form works and adds new project to list
- [ ] Delete project button removes project from list
- [ ] Projects page uses theme CSS variables (dark/light mode support)
- [ ] No console errors
- [ ] Fetching, creating, and deleting projects calls correct API endpoints
- [ ] Page is responsive and accessible

## Dependencies
- **Internal**: Wouter routing (feature 1), ProjectManager component logic (existing)
- **External**: None
